content: Ãtur biyaraimma aram oiye
Hoekdin bade, Isaye zehon abar Kofornahumot aišše, edde hiba górot asede funa giye.
Toi eto manuš dola oiye, dorozar bare udda ar zaga nu aššil. Hibaye hitarare kalam tobolig goijjede šomot,
ekzon ãtur biyaraimmare loi hoekzon manuš hibar hãse aišše, manušware sairzone boi ainne,

kintu zamila buli hitara hitare Isar hãse loizai no fare, hetolla Isa zeṛe aššil he borabor hitara góror salor uwore uiṭṭe edde ekkan fõt goijje, ar ze bisanar uwore ãtur biyaraimmawa aššil, hiyanor uwore gori hitare nise lamai diye.
Hitarar biššaš dekiyore, Isaye he ãtur manušware hodde,

content.text: "Fuwa, tor guna okkol maf gora oiye."

content: Heṛe hoekzon alem boiṛa aššil edde hitara nize nize bafa šuru goijje,
"Ei manušwaye endilla kiyolla hor? Hite kuferi gorer, šude Allah bade ar honokiye guna maf gori di no fare?"
Hitara in okkol bafedde Isaye hibar dilor butore hehon buzi faijje, edde hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: Ei ãtur biyaraimmare honnan howa asan oibo, 'tor guna maf gora oiye', ne naki 'tui uṭ, tor bisana lo edde aṭ'?
Kintu duniyait guna maf gori dibar kemota Adomor fuwattu ase, hiyan zene tũwara zani faro."

content: Hen hoi Isaye he leng manušware hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tore hoir, uṭ, bisana tuli loiyore gór zagoi."

content: Hetunot hite uṛi hitar bisana tuli loiye edde beggunor sarmottu baire niyoli giyegoi. Henot beggune tajjuf oiye edde hitara Allar tarif goriyore hodde, "Ãra endilla ar hono oktot no deki."
Levire Isar fisa loibolla ḍaikke
Isaye abar niyoliyore doriyar farot giye, heṛe beši manuš okkol hibar hãse aišše, toi hibaye hitarare šikka diye.
Tarfore hibaye fõt bai zat maze dekedde Alfeyusor fuwa Levi hazna adai gorede zagat boiṛa, Isaye hitare hodde,
Toi Leviye uiṭṭe edde hibar fisa loiye.

Tarfore Isaye hitar górot gorba giye, ar heṛe bout hazna adaigoroya okkol edde gunagar manuš okkol, Isa edde hibar sahabi okkolor fũwati hánar ṭebilot boišše, kiyollahoile boute aššil zara hibar fisa loil.

Foroši dolor alem okkole zehon Isa hazna adaigoroya edde gunagar manuš okkolor fũwati hána hadde deikke, hitara sahabi okkolore hodde, "Hibaye hazna adaigoroya edde gunagar okkolor fũwati kiyolla hána hár?"
Isaye ei hota fuinne edde hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Araimma mainšottu ḍakṭoror dorhar nai, kintu biyaraimma mainšottu dorhar ase. Ãi forhesgar okkolore no, kintu gunagar okkolore ḍakito aišši."

content: Ruzar babute šikka
Foroši okkole edde Yahyar šagirit okkole ruza rakkil. Toi hoekzone Isar hãse aiyore fusar goijje, "Foroši edde Yahyar šagirit okkole ruza rake, kintu õnor sahabi okkole kiyolla hen no gore?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Dula fũwati taite kengori dular fũwajja okkole ruza raki faribo? Dula zetodin hitarar fũwati ase, hitara ruza raki no faribo.
Kintu en šomoi aiyer, zẽtte hitarar hãsottu dulare loi zaiboi, edde toi he dinot hitara ruza rakibo."
"Honokiye furan kurutat noya horor tali no sila. Kiyollahoile, he furan kurutattu noya taligan siri aibo, ar henot hanagan aro ḍõr oibo.

Ar furan samorar hoillat honokiye tottoza šoraf no ḍale, kiyollahoile ḍalile šorafgune hoillagunore o fuṛaifelaibo, henot šoraf edde hoilla dunigun borbat oi zaiboi. No, tottoza šoraf noya samorar hoillat!"

content: Isa edde dórmor din
Hono ek dórmor din Isaye fõtot hono ek gĩyuketi bai gil, ar hibar sahabi okkole ãṛi zat maze giyũrdanar sora sijje.
Henot Foroši okkole hodde, "So, ain mozin dórmor din zin gora mana hitara hin kiyolla gorer?"
Hibaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Daud edde hibar fũwajja okkolottu zehon buk laggil edde haiddor obaf aššil hẽtte hibaye ki goijje, hin tũwara honodin no foro?
Obiyator ḍõr imam aššilde ṭaimot, hibaye Allar górot goillil edde sarme rakkilde ruṭi háil, zin šude imam okkol sara ar honokiye háibar mana aššil. Hibaye aro hibar sãti okkolore o dil."

content: Isaye hitarare aro hodde,

content.text: "Manušolla dórmodin gora oiyede, kintu dórmor dinolla manuš gora no o.
Hetolla Adomor Fut oilde dórmogóror uwore o malik."
